changes.title: Trump Battles GOP Holdouts Amid Democrats’ Factional Fight
changes.summary: Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins NBC’s Hallie Jackson on Sunday TODAY to discuss President Donald Trump’s conflict with fellow Republicans over Todd Blanche’s nomination as Democrats face an ideological battle in Tuesday’s Congressional Primary in Michigan.

changes.title: Trump Calls for $1.8 Billion Fund Over Blanche Attorney General Fight
changes.summary: The president vowed to push for the payout fund if Senate Republicans fail to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general, reigniting a dispute over the settlement.

changes.title: Trump poses ultimatum on Blanche, will push for "anti-weaponization fund" if AG not confirmed
changes.summary: Todd Blanche previously repeatedly told Congress the "anti-weaponization fund" was "dead.".

changes.title: Week in Politics: Todd Blanche nomination; Michigan's Democratic Senate shakeup
changes.summary: Two nominations to watch: President Trump's of Todd Blanche to be U.S. Attorney General, and who Michigan Democrats will choose Tuesday to campaign for the U.S. Senate.

changes.title: Trump says he’ll revive ‘anti-weaponization’ fund if Blanche’s nomination for AG is blocked
changes.summary: Trump threatened to “push hard” to keep a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund active, amid an ongoing feud between two Republican senators and the Trump administration over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general.

changes.title: Todd Blanche’s Loyalty to Trump Is Putting His Attorney General Confirmation at Risk
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s approach has collided with the jury-of-two reality in the Senate that has, thus far, kept him from the prize he covets: the stability and status conferred by a Senate confirmation.

changes.title: Trump appeals ruling that found his $10B IRS suit aimed to ‘manipulate’ legal proceedings
changes.summary: The case is at the center of negotiations between two Republican senators and the Justice Department over Todd Blanche’s nomination to serve as attorney general.

changes.title: Trump says he may pull Todd Blanche's nomination to circumvent GOP holdouts
changes.summary: President Trump says he's willing to hold his nomination of Attorney General Todd Blanche until January, when he says he'll have an easier political calculation in the Senate.
